description: Update an existing CloudArch diagram. You can change the code, name, description, or other fields. Provide either id (UUID) or slug to identify the diagram.

id.description: The diagram ID (UUID) to update. Either id or slug must be provided.

readme.description: Updated Markdown README. Same authoring guide as on create_diagram: ## Overview / ## Components / ## Scenarios / ## Tradeoffs / ## References, ~150-400 words, [LABEL] prefixes, no emojis. Use :concept{slug="..."} and :case{slug="..."} inside prose; use ::concept{slug="..."} and ::case{slug="..."} only as standalone leaf directives. Use exact public slugs with matching sections; link explore diagrams with Markdown to /v/<slug>; never leave a dead badge.

slug.description: The diagram slug to update. Either id or slug must be provided. If slug is given, the ID is resolved automatically.

name: update_diagram
